name: Venn Upwhere
acting: Five raised eyes and a pinched, bewildered mouth.
personality: Checks the ceiling before he checks the news.
bio: HyperNorm recruited Venn to maintain five points of visual contact. It now pays him to look away from four of them.
note: All five witnesses were present. Unfortunately they shared a body.
call: Which one of me saw that?

name: Grom Portside
acting: One sideways eye and a small diagonal frown.
personality: Treats docking instructions as personal criticism.
bio: Grom pilots the smallest saucer that can legally be called a HyperNorm vehicle. The regulation is measured from his waist.
note: He arrived five minutes late and insisted the saucer had been early.

name: Nia Crossband
acting: Uneven lids, sidelong gaze and a quiet smile.
personality: Hears the part of a message its sender left out.
bio: Nia tunes incident reports for HyperNorm. The unapproved channel is generally the one with the best reception.
note: She held up one finger. I heard the official version catch up with us.

name: Kel Hindsight
acting: Eyes follow an ink curl, with a small round gasp.
personality: Is regularly startled by a thought he just had.
bio: Kel keeps his working notes visible under glass. HyperNorm sent a cloth to help him achieve discretion.
note: The committee admired the dome. Kel had been hoping they'd notice the brain.

name: Mara Fallup
acting: Eyes track the pebbles and cheeks puff with concentration.
personality: Collects small exceptions to the law of falling.
bio: Mara checks that the pieces thrown up by a HyperNorm demolition come down in the authorized order. Some keep their own hours.
note: She recovered three pebbles and the principle on which they had been overlooked.

name: Pim Loopback
acting: Looks down at the portal with a delighted open smile.
personality: Takes shortcuts with the same hand he waves goodbye with.
bio: Pim fitted a pocket portal to the HyperNorm service corridor. An inspection of the other end took less time than deciding which end to inspect.
note: I shook his hand twice. He claimed only one arrival.
